files.name: main.py
files.code:
from sklearn.datasets import make_moons
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.svm import SVC

X, y = make_moons(n_samples=300, noise=0.25, random_state=0)   # hai nửa vầng trăng
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=0)

linear = SVC(kernel="linear").fit(Xtr, ytr)
rbf = SVC(kernel="rbf", C=1, gamma="scale").fit(Xtr, ytr)
print("linear:", round(linear.score(Xte, yte), 3))
print("rbf   :", round(rbf.score(Xte, yte), 3))
print("số support vector:", rbf.n_support_)

prompt.vi: Huấn luyện SVC(kernel='rbf') trên tập train của make_moons (noise=0.25, random_state=0; chia 70/30 random_state=0). Gán acc_rbf (phải trên 0.9).
prompt.en: Train SVC(kernel='rbf') on the train set of make_moons (noise=0.25, random_state=0; a 70/30 split with random_state=0). Assign acc_rbf (above 0.9).

from sklearn.datasets import make_moons
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.svm import SVC

X, y = make_moons(n_samples=300, noise=0.25, random_state=0)
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=0)
acc_rbf = SVC(kernel="rbf").fit(Xtr, ytr).score(Xte, yte)
print(round(acc_rbf, 3))

prompt.vi: So sánh kernel tuyến tính: gán acc_linear (SVC(kernel='linear')) và acc_rbf. Dữ liệu 'vầng trăng' không tách tuyến tính được nên RBF phải tốt hơn.
prompt.en: Compare with the linear kernel: assign acc_linear (SVC(kernel='linear')) and acc_rbf. The 'moons' data isn't linearly separable so RBF must do better.

solution.code:
from sklearn.datasets import make_moons
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.svm import SVC

X, y = make_moons(n_samples=300, noise=0.25, random_state=0)
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=0)
acc_linear = SVC(kernel="linear").fit(Xtr, ytr).score(Xte, yte)
acc_rbf = SVC(kernel="rbf").fit(Xtr, ytr).score(Xte, yte)
print(round(acc_linear, 3), round(acc_rbf, 3))
